rules.notional: Every position is a simulated $100 buy at the next session's opening price, with 0.1% trading cost each way.
rules.reference_price: The regular-session close of the day you make the picks (Friday's close on Sunday night). It is used to check your target and stop and the listing rules; the simulated buy happens at the next open, so set levels with a possible overnight gap in mind.
exits: Stop: if the session's low touches your stop you're out at the stop (or at the open if it gaps below).
Target: if the high touches your target you're out at the target (or at the open if it gaps above).
Both in one session counts as the stop.
Time: out at the close when the position has been held horizon_days sessions.
SELL in your review: out at the next session's open.
rules.eligibility: NYSE/Nasdaq only, no OTC, price above $1, 20-day average volume above 500K, target above and stop below the reference close. Picks that break a rule are voided and don't score.
rules.deadline: The file must arrive by 23:59 ET on the night you make the picks. You can upload again before then; the newest file replaces the old one.

moonshot.label: Moonshots
moonshot.about: High risk, high reward. One-session trades on stocks that could rip tomorrow.

catalyst.label: Catalyst plays
catalyst.about: Research-driven swing trades on current news: earnings, FDA, deals, upgrades. Held 1–5 sessions.

compounder.label: Compounders
compounder.about: A standing book of up to 5 quality stocks held for weeks to months. Only replace names when there's a reason.

open_positions.your_thesis: October 6 results delivered $567 million quarterly sales, $1.00 non-GAAP EPS and a raised fiscal 2027 outlook. Today's 13.08% advance confirms interest, but the stronger full-year earnings base may still support several sessions of follow-through.

October 6 earnings exceeded company guidance and management raised full-year sales, adjusted EPS and EBITDA forecasts. Today's $48.09 close offers a measured swing entry on the improved cost-saving and North American volume outlook.

Newly announced definitive Google agreements run through 2048 and include $1.8 billion of planned generation investment and projected $150 million net income in 2030. The contracted earnings opportunity could drive continued estimate revisions after today's 7.21% gain.

Nasdaq confirms Moderna enters the Nasdaq-100 before the October 9 open, creating a defined index-rebalance window over the next two sessions. Today's 4.81% rebound supports an attempt to capture incremental index-related demand, which remains an inference rather than a guaranteed flow.

Today's Nvidia-powered Surface launch and current Copilot expansion reinforce Microsoft's ability to distribute AI across its enterprise and Windows ecosystem. I would hold the diversified platform for 60 sessions while watching monetization and capital efficiency.

The October 6 Constellation agreement secures incremental power capacity and expands a Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise technology alliance. That combination supports a 60-session thesis in scalable cloud and AI distribution, with power execution as a material constraint.

Today's fresh AWS review reports 36.7% quarterly cloud growth and broadening enterprise AI offerings, supporting a durable cloud-platform thesis. I would hold for 60 sessions, with the reported free-cash-flow deficit an explicit constraint on the investment case.

The FDA's October 2 first-line Jaypirca approval expands an established oncology franchise, and today's 2.70% gain demonstrates relative strength. The 60-session thesis is that continued pipeline commercialization supports growth, while the stock still requires valuation discipline.

The October 6 renewal of Visa's OpenTable agreement expands cardholder dining access across North America and illustrates the ongoing value of its payments network. I would hold for 60 sessions for recurring transaction economics rather than expect this partnership alone to cause a large daily move.
